cases.label: 한글·이모지 바이트가 임의 chunk 경계에서 잘려도 두 레코드를 집계한다
cases.probe: const {Readable,Writable}=await import('node:stream'); const {Buffer}=await import('node:buffer'); let text=''; const output=new Writable({write(chunk,enc,done){text+=chunk.toString();done();}}); const bytes=Buffer.from('{"name":"한글 🍋","amount":3}\n{"name":"둘","amount":-1}\n');const chunks=[...bytes].map(byte=>Buffer.from([byte])); const result=await submission.aggregateNdjson(Readable.from(chunks),output);observe({result,text});

cases.label: CRLF·빈 줄·마지막 개행 없는 줄을 구분해 처리한다
빈 입력은 정상 빈 집계를 한 번 출력한다
cases.probe: const {Readable,Writable}=await import('node:stream'); const {Buffer}=await import('node:buffer'); let text=''; const output=new Writable({write(chunk,enc,done){text+=chunk.toString();done();}}); const result=await submission.aggregateNdjson(Readable.from([]),output);observe({result,text});

cases.label: 멀티바이트 줄이 바이트 상한을 넘으면 출력 없이 거부한다
cases.probe: const {Readable,Writable}=await import('node:stream'); const {Buffer}=await import('node:buffer'); let text=''; const output=new Writable({write(chunk,enc,done){text+=chunk.toString();done();}}); const input=Readable.from([Buffer.from('{"name":"한글","amount":1}\n')]);let name='';try{await submission.aggregateNdjson(input,output,{maxLineBytes:26});}catch(error){name=error.name;}observe({name,text,inputDestroyed:input.destroyed,outputDestroyed:output.destroyed});

cases.label: 뒤쪽 JSON 오류가 앞쪽 집계를 정상 결과로 내보내지 않게 한다
cases.probe: const {Readable,Writable}=await import('node:stream'); const {Buffer}=await import('node:buffer'); let text=''; const output=new Writable({write(chunk,enc,done){text+=chunk.toString();done();}}); let name='';try{await submission.aggregateNdjson(Readable.from([Buffer.from('{"name":"ok","amount":1}\n{broken}\n')]),output);}catch(error){name=error.name;}observe({name,text});

cases.label: 잘못된 UTF-8·숫자 문자열·합 오버플로를 각각 거부한다
느린 Writable의 쓰기와 final 완료를 기다려 성공을 반환한다
cases.probe: const {Readable,Writable}=await import('node:stream');const {Buffer}=await import('node:buffer');const events=[];let text='';const output=new Writable({highWaterMark:1,write(chunk,e,done){events.push('write');setTimeout(()=>{text+=chunk.toString();events.push('written');done();},15);},final(done){setTimeout(()=>{events.push('final');done();},5);}});const result=await submission.aggregateNdjson(Readable.from([Buffer.from('{"name":"a","amount":4}\n')]),output);events.push('returned');observe({result,text,events,finished:output.writableFinished});

cases.label: 출력 스트림의 오류를 같은 실패로 전달한다
cases.probe: const {Readable,Writable}=await import('node:stream');const failure=Object.assign(new Error('destination unavailable'),{code:'EIO'});const input=Readable.from([Buffer.from('{"name":"a","amount":1}\n')]);const output=new Writable({write(chunk,e,done){done(failure);}});let same=false;try{await submission.aggregateNdjson(input,output);}catch(error){same=error===failure;}observe({same,inputDestroyed:input.destroyed,outputDestroyed:output.destroyed});

cases.label: 완료 전 AbortSignal 취소가 입력·출력을 파괴하고 부분 요약을 내보내지 않는다
cases.probe: const {Readable,Writable}=await import('node:stream'); const {Buffer}=await import('node:buffer'); let text=''; const output=new Writable({write(chunk,enc,done){text+=chunk.toString();done();}}); const controller=new AbortController();const input=new Readable({read(){}});const operation=submission.aggregateNdjson(input,output,{signal:controller.signal});setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),10);setTimeout(()=>input.push(null),30);let name='';try{await operation;}catch(error){name=error.name;}observe({name,text,inputDestroyed:input.destroyed,outputDestroyed:output.destroyed});

cases.label: 줄 상한의 타입·최소·최대 범위를 시작 전에 검증한다
cases.probe: const {Readable,Writable}=await import('node:stream');const errors=[];for(const maxLineBytes of [0,-1,1.5,'10',1048577]){const input=Readable.from([]);const output=new Writable({write(c,e,done){done();}});try{await submission.aggregateNdjson(input,output,{maxLineBytes});errors.push('returned');}catch(error){errors.push(error.name);}finally{input.destroy();output.destroy();}}observe(errors);
